capabilities: Render TikZ code blocks with a local TeX distribution
Show compiler logs and error hints for failed diagrams
Cache rendered SVGs in the plugin folder
Open diagrams in a zoomable viewer
Share rendered diagrams with mobile devices
extras: Mobile devices can only display diagrams shared from a desktop; they cannot compile. Shell escape is off by default, and TeX can read any file the user account can access.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in TikZ compiler, and browser-based renderers cannot use the full local LaTeX installation or show real compiler logs.

requires.name: TeX distribution with dvisvgm (TeX Live, MacTeX or MiKTeX)

summary: TikZ code block renderer that compiles diagrams with a local TeX distribution and caches the resulting SVGs.
